clues.text: Elijah the Tishbite told this king of Israel there would be neither dew nor rain except at his word.
In the third year of drought, this king of Israel met Elijah and called him the troubler of Israel.
This king of Israel married the daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Sidonians, and then served Baal.
This king lay on his bed, face turned away, refusing to eat because a Jezreelite would not sell his vineyard.
After Aram's defeat, this king of Israel took Ben-hadad into his chariot and released him by a treaty.
When Elijah pronounced doom on his house, this king tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and fasted.
At Elijah's call, this king of Israel gathered all the Israelites and the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel.
